capabilities: Speak the target note's H1 heading when hovering an internal link
Fall back to the filename when the target has no H1
Configure TTS command, voice, speech rate, and hover trigger delay
Override voice and rate with a custom arguments template
extras: Desktop only (needs the Node.js child_process API); Linux users must install speech-dispatcher or espeak. Community plugin listing is still pending review, so installation currently requires a manual download.
problem: Obsidian gives no audio preview of what a link points to, so you must open the note to see its title.

requires.name: System TTS engine (macOS say, Linux spd-say/espeak, Windows PowerShell SpeechSynthesizer)

summary: Hover-to-speak plugin that reads the H1 heading of a note's internal link target aloud using the system TTS engine.
